history.summary: Freehold 3BR (1130sqft) at De Paradiso, a 2005 boutique development in D12 Balestier/Novena fringe, at $1.999M / $1,769 PSF — priced ~11% above the $1,593 URA median, with thin data (4.6% on 7 txns) and a weak score (437). Freehold + Novena proximity are the appeal; aging boutique and above-median entry are the drag.
history.rating_rationale: $1,769 PSF vs $1,593 URA median = ~11% premium for a 21-year-old boutique block. The 4.56%/yr URA rate is from only 7 txns (low confidence). Score 437 / Elo 1192 with a near-.500 but draw-heavy 260-263-46 record. Novena MRT is 1.21km (not walkable) — Balestier is a transit-light fringe. $1.999M sits at the upper edge of the liquid band. Freehold and the central-fringe Novena/medical-hub location give some resale support, but you are paying above median for an aging small development.
red_flags: URA 4.6% from only 7 txns — low confidence
